author: Sam Stewart
ai_announcement: AI announcement: Prepared with OpenAI Codex assistance; education, not investment advice.
cost_status: Assumed common annual drag for one falsification test; not measured trading costs or a fee quote. Fund expenses already embedded; taxes not modeled.

decision.condition: Written CIO objective and S9 loss definition, documented implementation costs, and a preregistered point-in-time protocol before any prospective shadow trial.
decision.monitor: Monthly audit of source/vintage receipts, reserve coverage, modeled and observed costs, overrides and allocation changes; daily reserve check in any future implementation.
decision.kill_rule: Stop the shadow trial at the first unavailable required vintage, unexplained source mismatch, reserve below 3%, unapproved turnover above 25%, or breach of the CIO-approved loss rule.
decision.reversal_trigger: Committee may approve a new zero-live-capital shadow protocol only after the written conditions are met. Live adoption requires a separate decision and evidence; twelve months cannot validate a rolling five-year return objective.
